Numeraire (NMR) is an ERC-20 utility token created by Numerai, a hedge fund in San Francisco. Data scientists stake NMR on stock market predictions, creating the Stake-Weighted Meta Model powering the fund. Numerai rewards or burns staked NMR to align incentives with long-term success of the fund.
